results.title: Almost all brokers predicting revenue growth - Insurance Times
results.content: * NEW: Five Star Rating Report 2026. + Opinion: Is there an optimal size for a retail insurance broker? + Briefing: Placement is becoming a balancing act for brokers. ‘Insurance brokers are optimistic about growth in their sector and ambitious to expand their own businesses too,’ says chief executive. The research – consisting of a survey of 100 UK brokers conducted in March 2026 and released yesterday (7 May 2026) – found that 54% of brokers expected to see revenue growth of between 5% and 10% across the next 12 months. A further 42% of brokers predicted growth of 10% to 15%, meaning that some 96% of firms currently hold a strongly optimistic view of the market. AIH suggested that firms were expecting to see a plateauing of the soft market by the fourth quarter of 2026, helping to reinstate healthy profits. Matthew Collins, chief executive at AIH, said: “Insurance brokers are optimistic about growth in their sector and ambitious to expand their own businesses too.
